channel.title: Dallas Next Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Dallas Next Media (dallasinnovates.com)

item.title: RealPage Appoints Fintech Veteran as Its First Chief Fintech Officer
item.description: RealPage has appointed Zahir Khoja as its first Chief Fintech Officer to lead financial technology strategy, payments, and financial services operations.

item.title: The Last Word: Micron VP On Why Richardson Students Are 'a Direct Part of Our Industry's Future'
item.description: Micron Foundation has awarded a $96,500 STEM grant to Richardson ISD to support robotics, coding, and AI-focused learning for elementary students.

item.title: Calendar: Not-to-Miss Events for Innovators in Dallas-Fort Worth
item.description: North Texas has plenty to see, hear, and watch. Here are our editors' picks. Plus, you'll find more selections to "save the date."

item.title: Dallas' Jacobs Completes $1.6B Acquisition of Remaining Stake in London's PA Consulting
item.description: Since Jacobs took a 65% stake in PA Consulting in 2021, the London-based company has helped expand Jacobs' footprint and services in advisory, digital, data and technology-enabled solutions, reinforcing the company's work in infrastructure, advanced manufacturing, energy and life sciences.

item.title: McKinsey Exec To Join CBRE as Chief Technology &amp; Transformation Officer
item.description: In addition to advising some of the world's leading AI, cloud, and technology companies on key strategies, M&amp;A, and commercial operations, Anuj Kadyan has led large-scale technology and AI transformations for major companies in other industries, Dallas-based CBRE said.

item.title: IKS Health Snaps Up Team at NYC-Based ThinkDTM
item.description: IKS Health announced an acquihire of ThinkDTM, bringing founder Tij Bedi and his team to expand its patient access solutions.

item.title: Keurig Dr Pepper Closes $18B JDE Peet's Acquisition, Names CEO of Future Global Coffee Co.
item.description: Keurig Dr Pepper JDE Peet’s acquisition closes as KDP moves forward with plans to create a Global Coffee Co and separate beverage business.

item.title: A New Professional Hub Is Coming to Dallas: Kiln to Launch Two Premium Workspaces in Preston Hollow and Plano
item.description: Kiln is launching two premium coworking spaces in Dallas and Plano, expanding its flexible workspace model into North Texas.

item.title: Coppell-Based The Container Store To Be Acquired by Bed Bath & Beyond for $150M
item.description: Bed Bath & Beyond agreed to acquire Coppell-based The Container Store in a $150 million deal, with plans to rebrand locations under both names.

item.title: AECOM and SMU Partner to Invest in Future of AI Infrastructure Talent
item.description: AECOM partnered with SMU to launch an AI research and workforce development program focused on infrastructure engineering and doctoral fellowships.

item.title: North Texas-Based Michaels Partners With Jonathan Adler on New Collection
item.description: Michaels partnered with designer Jonathan Adler to launch an exclusive home decor and craft collection in stores and online starting April 17.

item.title: Sally Beauty Holdings Names Former Bed Bath & Beyond President as CFO
item.description: Sally Beauty Holdings named Adrianne Lee as chief financial officer, succeeding Marlo Cormier at the Plano-based company.

item.title: The Biggest Counter-Strike eSports Event of 2026 Is Coming to Fort Worth
item.description: BLAST Premier Rivals Fort Worth 2026 will bring a Counter-Strike esports event to Dickies Arena with eight teams competing for a $1 million prize pool.

item.title: Nanoscope Therapeutics Names Former Alcon Exec as Its New COO
item.description: Nanoscope Therapeutics Inc. has named Paul Hallen as chief operating officer as it advances commercialization of its MOGENRY gene therapy.

item.title: 45 North Texas Companies Make Inc.’s 2026 Southwest Fastest-Growing List
item.description: Inc. named 45 North Texas companies to its 2026 Southwest fastest-growing companies list, led by Dallas-based JobTread Software at No. 5.
